tools.name: analyze_domain_features
tools.description: Examine a registrable domain's spelling, label length, suffix, structural brand fit and possible industries. Rule-based only; no claim of trademark clearance.

tools.name: analyze_domain_value
tools.description: Give a transparent, broad illustrative USD structural price reference based on name and suffix, plus a 0-100 structural score. Does not fetch comparable transactions or guarantee resale value.

tools.name: get_domain_history
tools.description: Read registration RDAP and available ICP filing evidence. Additional archive sources are disabled by default until stability is verified. Does not expose registrant PII.

tools.name: check_domain_risk
tools.description: Check observed registry RDAP status and reported risk signals. Unstable backlink and network sources are disabled by default until verified; missing data is not a clean-risk finding.

tools.name: compare_domains
tools.description: Compare two distinct registrable domains' transparent structural brand features and heuristic value. Does not certify market liquidity, ownership, trademark safety or registerability.
